description:
The rule inventory: every built-in rule with what it needs, its effective criticality and published accuracy, plus every deployed custom rule.

What it does. Read-only, no network. built_in is never narrowed by the filters; a rule whose needs are absent skips, never passes. Read critical and criticalSource before trusting passed: true. rules is the custom-rule store, filterable by eval_type and enabled_only. Full detail: iris://capabilities.

When not to use it. To add, remove or pause a rule (deploy_rule, delete_rule); built-in rules cannot be.

Returns. JSON: rules, total, enabled_count, built_in, quarantined, plugins.

Errors. IRIS_INTERNAL_ERROR if the store cannot be read; a missing store is an empty list. Failures return {"error":{code,message,recovery}} with isError; follow recovery.

Siblings. deploy_rule — add a custom rule; delete_rule — remove, disable or re-enable one; evaluate_output — run the rules.

enabled_only.description: Return only enabled custom rules (a rule disabled with delete_rule stays in the store and does not fire)

eval_type.description: Filter the custom rules to one eval category (exact match); built_in is never filtered

name: list_rules
title: List Rules
